_doc: Serving numbers for FP8 packages run in bf16 (dequantized) on hardware without FP8. Key: sha256 of the FP8 package's model.safetensors. 'fitted': the dequantized variant's own numbers (written into the fallback's openone.json). 'pending': the app uses the bf16 package's openone.json numbers (an installed bf16 package with the matching weights wins over the embedded copy below) and marks them provisional.

openone.quality_vs_bf16: real-traffic mean |dp| vs bf16 0.0065-0.0078 (true FP8 0.011-0.015); about half of FP8's argmax flips; false alarms bf16 108 / fallback 114 / FP8 120; block leaks bf16 10 / fallback 11 / FP8 9 of 1,089
